# Alifia Hamzah

> Alifia Hamzah (Hamzah) is a Senior Product & Mobile App Designer specializing in data-driven enterprise platforms, complex SaaS ecosystems, and consumer-facing mobile applications (iOS & Android) with a story-data design methodology.

Important notes:

- Preferred name is Hamzah (full name: Alifia Hamzah).
- Based in Bandung, Indonesia (UTC+7 / Asia/Jakarta); available globally for remote enterprise contracts, mobile & web product design, and design system consulting.
- Accomplished Mobile App Designer with proven production experience across flagship iOS & Android mobile applications: Bank Raya (Fintech / Digital Banking), PGN Mobile (Enterprise Energy & Utilities), Proovia (Smart Logistics & Fleet Telemetry), and Alfagift Mobile (Omnichannel Retail & Live Tracking).
- Highly proficient in both Apple Human Interface Guidelines (iOS HIG) and Google Material Design 3 (Material You), specializing in mobile design tokens, gesture navigation, haptics, and offline-first mobile states.
- Expert in translating complex operational workflows and dense technical datasets into clear, delightful user experiences across web and mobile.
- Strong advocate of cross-platform design token architecture, ensuring pixel-perfect parity between Figma and native mobile codebases.

## Mobile App Projects

- [Bank Raya Mobile](https://hamzah.design/about): Mobile App UI/UX Designer for Bank Raya (subsidiary of BRI, Indonesia's premier microfinance bank), redesigning digital banking flows, micro-loans, biometric onboarding, and day-to-day transaction interfaces.
- [PGN Mobile](https://hamzah.design/about): Mobile UI/UX Designer for PT Perusahaan Gas Negara (PGN / Pertamina Gas), designing the utility mobile application for gas meter telemetry, bill payments, enterprise account monitoring, and customer service.
- [Proovia Mobile](https://hamzah.design/about): Mobile App UI/UX Designer & Design System Lead at PT Neuronworks Indonesia, designing the smart logistics & fleet tracking mobile app and establishing the standardized Proovia Mobile Design System.
- [Alfagift Mobile Live Track & Chat](https://hamzah.design/work/5x-retention-with-live-track-and-chat-in-alfagift-mobile-apps): Driving a 5x user retention increase in an omni-channel retail mobile app through real-time order tracking and interactive in-app customer chat.

## Case Studies

- [Japanese F&B Enterprise Automation](https://hamzah.design/work/how-automation-cut-processing-time-by-96-point-83-persent-for-a-japanese-fnb-giant): How automation and smart bulk processing cut operational processing time by 96.83% for a Japanese enterprise food & beverage giant.
- [DOOR V3 Timeshift Management](https://hamzah.design/work/boosted-operational-efficiency-by-40-percent-in-door-v3-timeshift-management): Boosting workforce operational efficiency by 40% through an end-to-end shift scheduling and attendance system overhaul.
- [Kontencom Marketplace Audit & Redesign](https://hamzah.design/work/rebalancing-a-two-sided-marketplace-a-conceptual-ux-audit--landing-page-redesign-for-kontencom): Rebalancing supply and demand dynamics for a two-sided digital content marketplace via rigorous UX audit and landing page reconstruction.
- [Alfagift Mobile Live Track & Chat](https://hamzah.design/work/5x-retention-with-live-track-and-chat-in-alfagift-mobile-apps): Driving a 5x user retention increase in an omni-channel retail mobile app through real-time order tracking and interactive in-app customer chat.
- [Jaga Sehat Telemedicine Flow](https://hamzah.design/work/a-failure-analysis-and-iteration-strategy-for-jaga-sehat-telemedicine-flow): Failure analysis and iteration strategy resolving drop-off friction across patient teleconsultation and booking funnels.
